about: 판매조회 수정 창(원본 E040206 2026-10-21 loginaa 실측) — 일자-No. 를 누르면 목록 위에 '판매입력(수정)' 창이 뜬다. 아래 버튼줄 저장(F8) · 저장/전표(F7) · 복사 · 반품처리 · 현금수금 · 이전 · 다음 · 닫기 · 삭제 · 보내기 · H · 최종이력. 수량 1 → 2 [저장(F8)] 말 없이 창이 닫히고 목록 1,100 → 2,200, 재고 −1 더 · 채권 +1,100. [삭제] '전표를 삭제하겠습니까? / - 판매' → 창이 닫히고 목록에서 사라짐, 재고 · 채권 처음으로. 판매할 재고 5 는 구매(API)로 넣고 끝에 지운다. [신규(F2)] 는 목록 위 '판매입력' 창, 수정 창 [복사] 는 신규 창으로 바뀌어 일자 오늘 · 새 번호로 저장(2026-10-21 원본 실측). node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/sales-edit-popup.json

shots.name: 준비 — QAJ1P · QAJ1-Z12 · 재고 5 구매(API), 처음 재고 · 채권을 적어 둔다
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); let p = (await g('/api/partners')).find((x) => x.code === 'QAJ1P'); if (!p) p = await (await fetch('/api/partners', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'QAJ1P', name: 'QA재고1-거래처', type: 'BOTH' }) })).json(); let it = (await g('/api/items')).find((x) => x.code === 'QAJ1-Z12'); if (!it) it = await (await fetch('/api/items', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'QAJ1-Z12', name: 'QA재고1-특가', category: 'MERCHANDISE', unitPrice: 0, safetyStock: 0 }) })).json(); const wh = (await g('/api/warehouses')).find((x) => x.code === 'WH-01'); const d = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const r = await (await fetch('/api/purchases', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ partnerId: p.id, warehouseId: wh.id, purchaseDate: d, taxable: true, remark: 'QA재고1 수정창 재고', lines: [{ itemId: it.id, quantity: 5, unitPrice: 200 }] }) })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('sep', JSON.stringify({ purchaseId: r.id, whId: wh.id, pId: p.id })); return r.id })()

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); const st = (await g('/api/stock')).filter((x) => x.itemCode === 'QAJ1-Z12' && x.warehouseId === S.whId).reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x.quantity), 0); const ar = (await g('/api/ledger/partner-balances?asOf=2099-12-31')).find((b) => b.partnerId === S.pId)?.receivable ?? 0; S.st = st; S.ar = ar; sessionStorage.setItem('sep', JSON.stringify(S)); return [st, ar] })()

shots.name: 판매조회 [신규(F2)] — 목록 위 '판매입력' 창(버튼 저장(F8) · 저장/전표(F7) · 다시 작성 · 현금수금 · 닫기 · 웹자료올리기), 1 × 1,000 = 1,100 저장하면 말 없이 닫힘
steps: js:(() => { window.__dlg = () => document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); window.__msgs = []; window.confirm = (m) => { window.__msgs.push(m); return true }; return true })()

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const s = (await (await fetch('/api/sales', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.remark === 'QA재고1 수정창').sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; const no = s.docNo.match(/SO-([0-9]{4})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{4})/); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); S.saleNo = s.docNo; S.label = `${no[1]}/${no[2]}/${no[3]} -${Number(no[4])}`; sessionStorage.setItem('sep', JSON.stringify(S)); return S.label })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); const st = (await g('/api/stock')).filter((x) => x.itemCode === 'QAJ1-Z12' && x.warehouseId === S.whId).reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x.quantity), 0); const ar = (await g('/api/ledger/partner-balances?asOf=2099-12-31')).find((b) => b.partnerId === S.pId)?.receivable ?? 0; return st === S.st - 1 && ar === S.ar + 1100 })()

steps: js:(() => { const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); window.__row = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(S.label) && t.innerText.includes('QA재고1-특가')); window.__dlg = () => document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="판매입력(수정)"]'); window.__msgs = []; window.confirm = (m) => { window.__msgs.push(m); return true }; return !!window.__row() })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); const st = (await g('/api/stock')).filter((x) => x.itemCode === 'QAJ1-Z12' && x.warehouseId === S.whId).reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x.quantity), 0); const ar = (await g('/api/ledger/partner-balances?asOf=2099-12-31')).find((b) => b.partnerId === S.pId)?.receivable ?? 0; return st === S.st - 2 && ar === S.ar + 2200 })()

shots.name: 수정 창 [복사] — 창이 '판매입력' 신규 창으로(원본 2026-10-21 실측), 품목줄 그대로 · 일자 오늘 · 번호는 저장 때 새로, [저장(F8)] 말 없이 닫힘 · 새 전표 2,200 · 재고 −2 · 채권 +2,200
steps: js:(() => { const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); window.__row = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(S.label) && t.innerText.includes('QA재고1-특가')); window.__dlg = () => document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); window.__row().querySelector('button.ec-link').click(); return true })()

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); const all = (await (await fetch('/api/sales', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.remark === 'QA재고1 수정창').sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id); const s = all[0]; const no = s.docNo.match(/SO-([0-9]{4})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{4})/); S.copyLabel = `${no[1]}/${no[2]}/${no[3]} -${Number(no[4])}`; sessionStorage.setItem('sep', JSON.stringify(S)); return all.length + ' ' + S.copyLabel })()

expect:(() => { const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep')); return S.copyLabel !== S.label && [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].some((t) => t.innerText.includes(S.copyLabel) && t.innerText.includes('2,200')) })()

finally: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sep') || '{}'); const left = (await (await fetch('/api/sales', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.remark === 'QA재고1 수정창'); for (const s of left) await fetch('/api/sales/' + s.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); for (const pu of (await (await fetch('/api/purchases', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.remark === 'QA재고1 수정창 재고')) await fetch('/api/purchases/' + pu.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return left.length })()
